newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia's president changes five ministers.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia's president changes five ministers.

text.p: Bolivian President Gonzalo Sanchez de Lozada has changed five of his 12 ministers as the country gears up for next year's elections, state television reported.

On Sunday night Sanchez de Lozada named Franklin Anaya to replace Carlos Sanchez Berzain as interior minister, and Raul Espana to take over from Rene Blattmann as justice minister. Sanchez Berzain and Blattmann quit to run for president.

Alfonso Kreidler will replace Jorge Otasevic as defence minister, Hugo San Martin will replace Reynaldo Peters in the Labour Ministry, and Mauricio Balcazar will take over from Guillermo Richter as social communication minister.

The three will campaign to support other candidates. All of the ministers leaving their jobs, and their replacements, are members of Sanchez de Lozada's party, the centre-right National Revolutionary Movement.
General elections are due on June 1.
